    API

    For programs on this computer (sidecar apps)

    JSON-RPC 2.0 at , every command, using the cookie file as Basic auth. Bitcoin-style clients work as is.

    For websites

    The web API at . Public reads need nothing; the rest need a key from below. It answers only this computer: a website you put online reaches it from its own server code, never visitors' browsers.

    Every command: GET /api/v1/routes or the method rpc.help. Full list in docs/API.md.

    Arcades on the mesh first: other V1.0 arcades' blocks, or an existing arcade's Core node. This waits up to a minute and a half for their answers, then uses the coin's own P2P network for anything left.

      Mine testnet

      Mines Pepecoin testnet blocks on this PC and pays your wallet. Mined coins can be spent after 240 blocks (about 4 hours).
